world.title: BJP trolls Pakistan PM with viral 'uncle paani pila dijiye' meme over SCO summit remark on IWT
world.summary: BJP trolled Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif after his comments on the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) during the SCO Summit. Sharif emphasized the importance of water as a regional issue and called for adherence to international agreements. In response, the BJP shared a video of Sharif with a humorous audio clip, mocking his remarks on the treaty.

world.title: Qatar says most Iran strikes targeted US military facilities
world.summary: Qatar reported that nearly all recent attacks were aimed at US military facilities, with no civilian areas affected. This information was corroborated by an official document submitted to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). The statement highlights the focus of the strikes during the conflict, emphasizing the absence of civilian casualties in the targeted operations.

world.title: 37 dead in oil theft attempt after inhaling toxic fumes in Nigeria
world.summary: At least 37 individuals died in Nigeria's Rivers State after inhaling toxic fumes while attempting to siphon crude oil from an illegal tapping point. The incident highlights the dangers associated with illegal oil extraction practices in the region. Authorities continue to address the ongoing issues related to oil theft and its severe consequences for local communities.

business.title: Vijayanand Travels places largest-ever private bus operator order with Volvo for 150 buses
business.summary: Vijayanand Travels has made a significant order for 150 Volvo 9600 sleeper coaches, marking the largest-ever order by a private bus operator. This order includes 70-80 coaches equipped with onboard washrooms, as the company aims to enhance its premium intercity bus services across India. The move reflects Vijayanand's strategy to expand its operations nationwide.

business.title: NSE IPO could be worth Rs 30,000 crore after Sebi gives green signal
business.summary: India's markets regulator, Sebi, has approved the National Stock Exchange's (NSE) initial public offering (IPO), which could be valued at Rs 30,000 crore. This marks a significant step for the NSE, enabling it to proceed with its stock market debut after a prolonged wait. The final observations from Sebi were received on Friday, facilitating this development.

business.title: Check Out The 2026 Kia Sorento In 21 Real-life Images!
business.summary: Kia has introduced the Sorento, its first hybrid vehicle in the Indian market. The Sorento features a self-charging hybrid powertrain and an optional diesel engine. Notable amenities include a 10-way powered driver seat and rear ventilated seats. The vehicle is designed with numerous features aimed at enhancing safety and comfort for passengers.

technology.title: Nvidia RTX Spark laptops, desktops arrive in October from six manufacturers
technology.summary: Nvidia has announced that its RTX Spark laptops and desktops will be available from six manufacturers starting in October. This marks Nvidia's entry into the CPU market, focusing on PCs designed for local AI applications. The announcement follows a series of previews and includes devices from companies like Microsoft and HP, showcased during this year's IFA event.

technology.title: Noise Master Buds Open with Sound by Bose unveiled at IFA Berlin 2026: Open-ear earbuds to launch in India in late September
technology.summary: Noise unveiled the Master Buds Open at IFA Berlin 2026, introducing its first open-ear earbuds utilizing Sound by Bose technology. This product is part of the Master Series and is set to launch in India in late September. The new earbuds aim to enhance audio experiences while providing an open-ear design for comfort and convenience.

technology.title: 27 Season 100 Times on NBA 2K27. Here Are the Results.
technology.summary: A simulation of the upcoming NBA season on NBA 2K27 was conducted 100 times to analyze potential outcomes. The results were recorded, showcasing the game's ability to reflect player ratings and team performance. While NBA 2K is not a perfect simulator, it provides a reasonably accurate representation of the league, offering insights into possible season scenarios.

sports.title: India-Japan set to play historic T20I in Sano
sports.summary: India and Japan will play their first-ever T20I match in Sano, marking a historic moment in international cricket. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and the Japan Cricket Association (JCA) announced the match, which will feature the reigning ICC Men's T20 World Cup champions, India, against the emerging cricketing nation of Japan.

sports.title: Charles Leclerc leads Lewis Hamilton and George Russell during first practice at the Italian Grand Prix
sports.summary: Charles Leclerc topped the opening practice session at the Italian Grand Prix, leading a Ferrari 1-2 with teammate Lewis Hamilton in second place. Mercedes driver George Russell finished third. The session featured various teams testing their setups, with Leclerc's performance indicating strong potential for the weekend ahead. The practice session set the stage for the upcoming qualifying rounds.

sports.title: India, Japan to play historic one-off T20I
sports.summary: India and Japan will play their first-ever international cricket match, a one-off T20I, on September 22 at the Sano International Cricket Ground in Tochigi Prefecture. This event marks the beginning of celebrations for the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries. The Board of Control for Cricket in India announced the match on Friday.

health.title: Psychedelic drug shows promise for preventing chemotherapy-induced nerve damage
health.summary: Recent studies indicate that psilocybin, a psychedelic drug, may prevent nerve damage associated with chemotherapy. Research conducted on mice shows that psilocybin preserves sensory nerve function, potentially leading to new treatments for chemotherapy-induced neuropathy. This condition often results in symptoms such as pain, numbness, increased sensitivity to cold, and loss of sensation, impacting patients' quality of life.

health.title: Time-Restricted Eating May Improve MASLD Outcomes
health.summary: Long-term research indicates that time-restricted eating may enhance outcomes for individuals with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH). The study found improvements in liver fat, fibrosis measures, and overall metabolic health among participants practicing this eating pattern. These findings suggest potential benefits of time-restricted eating for managing these liver conditions.

health.title: Timely medical decisions shape gynaecological cancer outcomes
health.summary: Timely medical decisions significantly impact outcomes for gynaecological cancer in India. Factors such as financial dependence, family responsibilities, social norms, limited autonomy, and unequal access to health services hinder women's access to prompt care. These barriers often lead to delays in symptom recognition and treatment, ultimately affecting survival rates and overall health outcomes for affected women.

science.title: The stage- and sex-specific transcriptome of the striped flea beetle Phyllotreta striolata
science.summary: Researchers have created a comprehensive transcriptomic atlas of the striped flea beetle, Phyllotreta striolata, covering its four life stages and sex-specific traits. RNA sequencing produced 334.5 million reads, confirming dataset reliability. This study aids in understanding the beetle's biology and supports future pest management strategies by identifying RNAi targets, enhancing species-specific dsRNA designs, and minimizing off-target effects.

science.title: shaped" Earth image reveals a hidden planetary reality
science.source: Futura, le média qui explore le monde
science.summary: In 1738, French scientists Pierre Bouguer and Charles Marie de La Condamine explored whether a mountain's mass could influence gravity's direction. Conducting their research in what is now Ecuador, they laid the groundwork for understanding gravitational variations caused by geological formations. This early investigation has implications for comprehending Earth's shape and gravitational anomalies, revealing a complex planetary reality.

science.title: Google-Aided Research Completes First Full Map Of Male Fruit Fly Brain's 1.6 Lakh Neurons
science.summary: Researchers have completed the first full map of a male fruit fly's brain, which contains 160,000 neurons. This project, aided by Google's AI technology, would have required approximately 50,000 person-years to accomplish manually. The fruit fly, a key model organism in scientific studies, continues to provide valuable insights into biological processes and neurological functions.

entertainment.title: Boney Kapoor's daughter Khushi Kapoor buys 180 sq.ft NEW property in Bandra West - Check Price
entertainment.summary: Actress Khushi Kapoor, daughter of producer Boney Kapoor, has acquired a new residential property in Bandra West, Mumbai. The flat measures 180 square feet and was purchased for Rs 63 lakh, as per property registration documents. This acquisition marks another step in her real estate investments in the upscale locality, known for its affluent residents and vibrant culture.

entertainment.title: What Hanuman Ansh gets right: Faith, simplicity and its appeal to an entire generation Bollywood forgot
entertainment.summary: "Hanuman Ansh" has resonated with audiences, grossing over ₹85 crore, particularly appealing to a generation that feels overlooked by Bollywood. The film's themes of faith and simplicity attract viewers, including those who rarely attend cinemas. A personal account highlights a family's renewed interest in theater, showcasing the film's ability to draw in audiences who have distanced themselves from mainstream cinema.

entertainment.title: Miss India World Nikita Porwal Is Inspired By...
entertainment.summary: Nikita Porwal showcased a contemporary interpretation of Goddess Meenakshi during the national costume round at Miss World 2026. Her vibrant outfit, designed by Torani, highlighted elements of Indian mythology, embodying the essence of the 'Goddess in Colour'. Porwal's presentation aimed to celebrate cultural heritage while participating in the prestigious beauty pageant, representing India on an international stage.
